entities.summary: Charles d'Albert, 3rd Duke of Chaulnes, was a French general and diplomat. He was made lieutenant genéleral of the armies in 1655, and chevalier des ordres du roi from 1661. He became third Duke of Chaulnes in 1653 on the death of his elder brother.
